prose/*.why: Prose sizes live only in Studio flavor (SF:prose/*); the build rule routes every theme-level binding through Theme set, so each SF prose variable got a Theme / Theme B / Theme set twin (hero/pad pattern)
prose/*.Theme / Theme B: each Theme set id minus 2 (Theme) and minus 1 (Theme B), e.g. prose/body/size Theme 594:153028, Theme B 594:153029
prose/*.values: Theme Studio → alias Studio flavor prose/* (173:336–351); every other Theme mode and every Theme B mode = the Utility literals 16/26, 19/30, 26/34/-0.4, 19/28/-0.2, 16/24, 13/22, 544, 720
prose/*.scopes: size FONT_SIZE, line LINE_HEIGHT, tracking LETTER_SPACING, measure/wide WIDTH_HEIGHT

type/em/style.why: Prose inline em needs an italic face; no style variable carried one
type/em/style.Studio flavor: 594:153077 (Italic in Utility, Cloud, Workshop, Playful, Ledger, Atelier; Regular in Signal: Geist Mono has no italic)
type/em/style.Theme: 594:153078 (Studio → Studio flavor; Italic in Ledger, Filigrane, Tonal, Glass, Fluent, Tactile, Pixel; Signal and Brutal alias type/body/style: Geist and Space Grotesk have no italic)
type/em/style.verified: each italic value checked against listAvailableFontsAsync for the mode's resolved font/sans

deviations: K1 Window chrome: state focused|hover|unfocused|disabled (spec focused|blurred|disabled): 'unfocused' per the brief, and 'hover' added to show the close affordance. Light/dark are Scheme modes, not a variant. The code's reload/hide/close actions map to the platform controls; no app-action Icon buttons.
K1 traffic lights use destructive/warning/success/default (Utility-neutral), not cupertino/traffic-*; the Cupertino style restyles them.

K2: no separate 'Tray menu item' set. The brief says reuse Menu content, so rows are O8 Menu item/label/separator instances; role items (About, Hide) are action rows without an accelerator. Accelerators are the Menu item's Kbd, not T.mono text. The Tray menu set adds state rest|disabled to the spec source axis (4).
K3 primary action is Button primary (primary/default), not an accent/default override: overriding the fill would detach it from the Button states; in Utility, Ink accent equals primary.

K4 Desktop notification: tone axis (5) added per the brief (10 variants); padding space/card/padding (code space-4, Toast precedent) instead of spec space/stack/gap; tone shows in the icon tile only (native notifications are not tinted); meta line (app · time) added as a boolean.

K5 Update prompt: state available|downloading|ready|manual|error per the brief (spec automatic|manual = ready|manual); manual uses the info tone (subtle + border + text), error the destructive tone, per the owner's content-colour rule; padding space/card/padding.
K6 Desktop only: annotation frame with a browser-vs-webview illustration (Update prompt instance), no set.
Desktop showcase: the App shell content slot is swapped to .Page content (Layout's own review does the same); the notification floats over the window corner like a system notification.

X1 Prose: bound to new Theme set prose/* twins instead of SF:prose/* (rule: theme-level variables only through Theme set). Lede max width is prose/measure (live CSS), not lit 640. Inline code inside p/ul uses font/mono + prose/code/size ranges (13; live is 0.875em = 14) without a chip; Prose inline/code is the chip. Prose block has no TEXT properties: a TEXT property would flatten the inline-code ranges. Non-link inline hovers equal rest (spec axis kept).
X2 File path chip follows the live CSS (padding 2/5, height 26, copy glyph at size/icon/sm 14 vs live 12) rather than spec h 24 / padding-x 8.
X3 Attribute chip has no border (live CSS) although the spec lists border/subtle.
X4 Toc item text is 13/20 (type/small/size + type/strong/line) to match the live 13/20; mobile Toc is the closed bar; the open state is not a variant.

X5 File tree row axes are type × ownership (8), not spec type × state × open (12): the live tree is read-only ('not an interactive ARIA tree') with no chevrons, hover, selection or indent guides. Row height 26 and indent 20 follow the live CSS (spec 28/16). Tag text is a per-variant layer (edit for [owned config], [generated history], [CLI-managed]).
X6 Figure image media is a surface/surface placeholder with a camera glyph (the plugin API used here cannot create image fills); replace the fill with the real image.
X7 Anchor nav: 'scrolled' moves the current anchor later and documents the pinned bar; Utility has no shadow, so there is no extra visual chrome. Tab default labels are 14/20 (live 13).

X8 Ruled grid nests a private '.Docs card' (live .ns-card anatomy: eyebrow, ↗ arrow, muted body, underlined action; ruled cells with a mono icon tile) instead of D3 Card, whose anatomy differs from the live docs card. Feature gap 32 (live) instead of space/section/gap (16).
X9 Hero: centered layout is not on the live site; it stacks the aside below a centred display column. Mobile title uses T.title (48/52) because there is no 44/48 variable (live 44/48).

Docs article showcase: the breadcrumb is Breadcrumb item instances with separator off plus mono '/' texts (the live docs breadcrumb uses '/', N1 uses a chevron); the callout is Alert info subtle with a custom title; code headers read 'Shell · bash' (D8 name + lang) where the live header shows 'Shell' + a Copy text button.
findings: Instances keep the FIXED sizing their main had when they were placed: after switching a main to hug, existing instances must be switched too (fixed in the Prose review).
A bottom/side stroke counted in auto layout shifts centred children by 0.5px; set strokesIncludedInLayout=false on rule-carrying bars.
Several Utility bindings are inert in other themes by design until styles land: traffic-light tones, Window chrome geometry (Cupertino/Liquid/Fluent K1 language variants per spec §1.1).

Live docs callouts/breadcrumb/code header details differ slightly from the base components (see deviations); a docs style pass could add a '/' separator option to Breadcrumb and a text 'Copy' action to Code block.
fonts: Host Grotesk Regular/Medium/Italic and Fragment Mono Regular; italic availability checked for all 24 theme/flavor fonts
